title: Codex workers: network and nvm setup for allow-listed commands
text: Codex workers run in a sandbox without network, so even routine commands like installing dependencies used to come to the owner as permission questions. Now a command the repository's trusted allow list covers gets network for that one run without a question. Usual shell setup in front of it, like `source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24`, needs no rule of its own, as long as the sourced file is one the worker can't change. Everything else still asks.
